title: AILIT_TRAVEL: Replication Archive
description: Replication archive for a sentence-embedding-based cross-national analysis of national AI-in-education policy text adoption against three independent AI competency frameworks (UNESCO Student, UNESCO Teacher, and OECD-European Commission AI Literacy Framework). Contains anchor sentences, adherence matrices, robustness battery outputs, clustering results, and figures for the 25-country corpus. Code: MIT License. Data: CC BY 4.0. During anonymous peer review the author block is anonymised; full attribution is added at publication.
